# Re-load the data to ensure consistency
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

print("Cross-tabulation of sex and treatment arm:")

# Total counts
print("\nTotal patients by sex:")
print(trial['sex'].value_counts())

# Total by arm
print("\nTotal patients by arm:")
print(trial['arm'].value_counts())"}
